title: Deleting a tag group: different wording for personal and public groups
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • A personal group and a public group you can delete.
custom_steps:
1. Delete a personal group and read the confirmation title, body and confirm button.
  2. Delete a public group and read its (different) confirmation body.
  3. Confirm and read the success message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Delete opens a confirmation titled "Delete tag group" with the confirm button "Delete".
  • For a personal group it reads "Are you sure you want to delete the tag group "<name>"?"; for a public group it reads "Are you sure you want to delete the tag group "<name>"? This is a public tag group: deleting it removes it for everyone at this location, and any note already tagged with it keeps its text but loses the group."
  • Confirming a delete confirms with "Tag group deleted".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R18: “Delete opens a confirmation titled "Delete tag group" whose confirm button reads "Delete".”
  • S6-R19: “For a personal group, the confirmation reads "Are you sure you want to delete the tag group "<name>"?"”
  • S6-R20: “For a public group, the confirmation reads "Are you sure you want to delete the tag group "<name>"? This is a public tag group: deleting it removes it for everyone at this location, and any note already tagged with it keeps its text but loses the group."”
  • S6-R21: “Confirming a delete confirms with the success message "Tag group deleted".”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
